landing.heroDesc: Unify DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, MiniMax, OpenRouter and more behind one balance, one invoice and one set of limits — an OpenAI-compatible gateway that works out of the box.
landing.heroNote: Sign up and start instantly — no credit card required. Free models cost nothing.
landing.badgeLedger: Double-entry ledger · accurate to the cent
landing.modelsSub: Chat, reasoning, multimodal and generative models land here continuously. Below is a selection at live pricing.
landing.pricingUnavailable: Pricing is temporarily unavailable. Try again later or browse the <link>pricing page</link>.
landing.featuresSub: Structured safeguards at every layer, from authentication and rate limiting to billing and reconciliation — not a proxy, but a payment-grade gateway.

unified.title: One OpenAI-compatible API
unified.desc: Point base_url here and you are done — DeepSeek, GLM, MiniMax and OpenRouter all converge on /v1/chat/completions with zero SDK changes.

wallet.title: Real-time billing wallet
wallet.desc: Two-phase holds and actual charges on a double-entry ledger keep every cent accountable; balance, bills and statements update in real time.

routing.title: Channel failover routing
routing.desc: Weighted priority routing across channels with automatic failover; procurement budgets and circuit breakers protect upstream cost.

playground.title: Keyless playground
playground.desc: Sign in and chat with any model right in the console — billed normally, with streaming exactly as your users will see it.

keys.title: Keys and quota management
keys.desc: Per-key RPM/TPM rate limits and daily spend caps; revocation is global, and brute force triggers automatic lockout.

reports.title: Usage reports
reports.desc: Usage and cost breakdowns by model, key and day — token-level billing you can audit at any time.

landing.ctaTitle: Ready? Get your first key in a minute
landing.ctaDesc: Register, top up, create a key — three steps to every model. Or try the playground for free first.

apiGuide.title: API Reference
apiGuide.subtitle: The gateway is fully OpenAI-compatible — your existing SDKs and code only need a new Base URL and API key.
apiGuide.quickStartDesc: Three steps: create an API key, swap the Base URL, call as usual.
apiGuide.streamDesc: Add stream: true to the request body and the response is SSE — your SDK handles it.
apiGuide.visionDesc: Pass an array as content to mix text and image_url; local images can be inlined as base64 data URLs.
apiGuide.imagesDesc: Text-to-image, billed per image produced; n controls the count.
apiGuide.audioDesc: Speech synthesis (TTS) returns audio bytes; transcription and translation use multipart uploads.
apiGuide.avDesc: Async jobs: submit, keep the task id, poll until succeeded, then fetch the output; billed per second or per item.
apiGuide.directDesc: No restructuring needed — point the Anthropic SDK here directly; Gemini uses its native path.
apiGuide.agentDesc: Create an application on the Applications page to get client_id/secret, then exchange it for a short-lived JWT — ideal for servers that avoid storing long-term keys.
apiGuide.modelsDesc: Every model your key can call (including mapped public names) — check here before choosing a model.
apiGuide.tableDesc: All inference endpoints require Authorization: Bearer; errors follow the OpenAI style (error.code / error.message).
apiGuide.cKeyComment: create it on the API Keys page
apiGuide.cModelsComment: see available models in "List models" below
apiGuide.cSseComment: SSE streaming: tokens arrive one by one
apiGuide.cVideoStep1: 1) Submit the job → 201 returns the task id
apiGuide.cVideoStep2: 2) Poll the job status (status: pending → processing → succeeded)
apiGuide.cAnthropicComment: Anthropic SDK direct: the gateway speaks the /v1/messages protocol
apiGuide.cJwtComment: For inference calls, use: Authorization: Bearer '<JWT>'
